status: sourced mechanical-bicycle proxy; complete e-bike purchase cost remains uncalibrated

source.title: 2025 Market Data for the Bicycle Industry
source.price_boundary: gross average sales price, all German sales channels
source.role: Non-electric price anchors mechanical prior; complete e-bike price is screening only.

assumptions: 12 kg reference mass is the model Human/Bicycle <25 glider, not a measured ZIV fleet mass.
1.2 is the existing reference markup; divide the retail anchor by this once, then the model applies its actual markup once. This does not identify factory cost or separate VAT.
Mass-proportional transfer to all three electric-bicycle gliders is a provisional engineering assumption.
New glider costs use constant real 2025 EUR across 2000-2050; other legacy cost inputs have not been re-based.
Retain each native year slope triangular relative bounds; these are engineering uncertainty, not a market-price confidence interval.
known_limits: Complete e-bike cost components and national/quality variation still need empirical qualification.
Kick-scooters, mopeds and small scooters retain their separate negative-glider-cost cases.
